messages:
alex: Hey team, vendor just flagged replacements for PO# 4912 — they can only commit ~70% of the exact SKUs. Need a plan for staggered replacements + RMA routing.

vendor_ops_bot: Automated RMA created: RMA-2026-4521 for PO 4912. See details: https://nexasupply.example.com/rma/RMA-2026-4521 :gear:

simon (NexaSupply): Sorry about the split — we had a batch-level QC fail on the 4090-64GB units. We can ship 24 of 32 immediately from our EU pool, remaining 8 are on hold pending replacement wafers.

priya: Can we accept partial shipments? Any customs complications if we split AWBs?

simon (NexaSupply): Yes partial OK. Two options:
1) Split AWB (fast for the 24, separate commercial invoice for the 8)
2) Consolidated AWB once full batch ready (ETA ~21 days).
Cost: expedited air for the 24 adds ~8% freight uplift.

gaby: If we do split AWBs we need consolidated commercial invoice and one customs HS code. Also need vendor to supply CN22/CI matching our SAP PO# or customs will hold.

michael: Heads up — the 8 on hold are currently running in our EU cluster; if they fail hardware checks we need RMA credit and serials for EOL tracking. Please include serial list in RMA.

simon (NexaSupply): putting serials in the RMA now. Quick snippet:```
SKU,serial,status
4090-64GB,SN-A3124,ready
4090-64GB,SN-A3125,ready
4090-64GB,SN-A3136,on_hold
...
```

alex: Good. For the partial ship: prioritize the nodes we marked as "quarantine" in the EU fab (see #eng-infra flag). Priya, can you approve the +8% uplift?

priya: Approving uplift for the 24 units if vendor provides one consolidated invoice per shipment and a credit note for any DOA discovered on arrival. :thumbsup:

gaby: I'll coordinate freight agent. Requesting NexaSupply to send AWB and commercial invoice at least 24h before pickup so we can pre-clear customs and book a courier slot.

simon (NexaSupply): AWB for partial: AWB-GB123456789. Pickup window tomorrow 09:00-14:00. Commercial invoice sent to customs@nexaredwood.example.com. We'll issue credit note template for any DOA.

michael: Once units arrive we'll QA on bench-2, set nodes to `drain` and tag with RMA-2026-4521. Gaby, can you request a same-day bench slot?

gaby: Booking bench-2 now. ETA to test 24 units: ~6 business hours after arrival. I'll post the testing checklist in the thread once scheduled. :calendar:

alex: Thanks — final ask to vendor: please confirm packing list, HS code, and whether you can include a manufacturer traceability sheet per unit (we need it for inventory). If you can't, we may need to hold for 48h.

simon (NexaSupply): Confirmed — packing list + MFG trace on each unit. Will attach to RMA portal. AWB label and CI emailed. We'll follow up if any timing changes. Apologies again for the disruption. :pray:

vendor_ops_bot: RMA-2026-4521 updated: partial-shipment AWB recorded (AWB-GB123456789). Status: in_transit.

alex: Great. Closing plan: ship 24 air now, hold 8 for consolidated later, vendor to issue credit note if DOA, ops to bench-and-verify on arrival. I'll follow up if customs flags anything.
